meta.title: Buyer cannot see technical evaluations before ranks are submitted and approved
gaps: Verify in the buyer view that technical rankings are hidden while approval is pending, provide all required technical-evaluation approvals, and verify that rankings become visible afterward.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify in the buyer view that technical rankings are hidden while approval is pending, provide all required technical-evaluation approvals, and verify that rankings become visible afterward.

steps.note: Open an existing event with a closed technical stage and a vendor response awaiting evaluation.
Open the Technical Stage where the evaluation is pending.
Submit the evaluator’s technical rankings before checking the approval-dependent buyer visibility.

args.need: in the buyer view, verify technical rankings remain hidden while approval is pending, provide all required technical-evaluation approvals, and verify the rankings become visible afterward
